fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for command generation and transport activity. When 0, the design remains in safe fallback behavior.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Operating mode selector for firmware-defined control behavior. Encoded value is implementation-defined but must remain stable across software and RTL releases.

fields.name: SAFE_STATE_SEL
fields.description: Selects deterministic safe actuator state. Reset default is conservative neutral/low-drag setting.

fields.name: CLR_STICKY
fields.description: Write 1 to clear sticky fault flags after firmware has sampled status.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved, reads as 0.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_TH[7:0]
fields.description: Programmable timeout threshold in clock cycles, low byte.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_TH[15:8]
fields.description: Programmable timeout threshold in clock cycles, high byte. The effective threshold is the 16-bit concatenation of TIMEOUT_TH_H:TIMEOUT_TH_L.

fields.name: CLAMP_MIN[7:0]
fields.description: Lower bound for actuator_cmd, low byte.

fields.name: CLAMP_MIN[15:8]
fields.description: Lower bound for actuator_cmd, high byte. The effective minimum is the 16-bit concatenation of CLAMP_MIN_H:CLAMP_MIN_L.

fields.name: CLAMP_MAX[7:0]
fields.description: Upper bound for actuator_cmd, low byte.

fields.name: CLAMP_MAX[15:8]
fields.description: Upper bound for actuator_cmd, high byte. The effective maximum is the 16-bit concatenation of CLAMP_MAX_H:CLAMP_MAX_L.

registers.name: STATUS0
registers.description: Sticky faults and live status flags.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK
fields.description: Registered safe fallback state indicator.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_VALID
fields.description: Indicates actuator_cmd was freshly updated from a validated request/response transaction.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_STICKY
fields.description: Sticky timeout fault; remains set until cleared by CLR_STICKY.

fields.name: STALE_STICKY
fields.description: Sticky stale-data rejection fault; remains set until cleared by CLR_STICKY.

fields.name: ENVELOPE_STICKY
fields.description: Sticky operating-envelope violation fault; remains set until cleared by CLR_STICKY.

fields.name: REQ_ACCEPTED
fields.description: Pulses or reflects that a request handshake was accepted most recently.

fields.name: RSP_VALID_SEEN
fields.description: Indicates at least one valid response has been observed since reset or clear.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved, reads as 0.

fields.name: LAST_REQ_SEQ[3:0]
fields.description: Low nibble of the last accepted request sequence.

fields.name: LAST_RSP_SEQ[3:0]
fields.description: Low nibble of the last accepted response sequence.

registers.name: STATUS2
registers.description: Age and timeout status, low byte.

fields.name: AGE_COUNTER[7:0]
fields.description: Current age counter low byte for the active transaction watchdog.

registers.name: STATUS3
registers.description: Age and timeout status, high byte.

fields.name: AGE_COUNTER[15:8]
fields.description: Current age counter high byte for the active transaction watchdog.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_CMD[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the registered, clamped actuator command.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_CMD[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the registered, clamped actuator command. The full command is ACTUATOR_CMD_H:ACTUATOR_CMD_L.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_TRACK_L
registers.description: Last accepted request sequence tracker, low byte.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_TRACK[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the last accepted request sequence counter.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_TRACK_H
registers.description: Last accepted request sequence tracker, high byte.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_TRACK[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the last accepted request sequence counter.

registers.name: RSP_SEQ_TRACK_L
registers.description: Last accepted response sequence tracker, low byte.

fields.name: RSP_SEQ_TRACK[7:0]
fields.description: Low byte of the last accepted response sequence counter.

registers.name: RSP_SEQ_TRACK_H
registers.description: Last accepted response sequence tracker, high byte.

fields.name: RSP_SEQ_TRACK[15:8]
fields.description: High byte of the last accepted response sequence counter.

sources.name: FAULT_IRQ
sources.description: Optional firmware-visible fault summary event derived from sticky timeout, stale-data, or envelope-violation status. No dedicated interrupt port is defined in the RTL contract; software may poll STATUS0 instead.

init_sequence: Write CTRL0.SAFE_STATE_SEL to the firmware-selected deterministic safe actuator state.
Write CLAMP_MIN and CLAMP_MAX to the desired actuator bounds, ensuring CLAMP_MIN <= CLAMP_MAX.
Write TIMEOUT_TH to the desired watchdog threshold.
Optionally write CTRL0.MODE and CTRL0.ENABLE=1 to begin operation.
Write CTRL0.CLR_STICKY=1 after initialization if firmware wants a clean status baseline.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS0 to monitor SAFE_FALLBACK, ACTUATOR_VALID, and sticky fault bits.
Read STATUS1 to observe last accepted request/response sequence tracking.
Read STATUS2/STATUS3 to monitor watchdog age.
Read ACTUATOR_CMD_L/ACTUATOR_CMD_H if software needs the last registered command value.
irq_sequence: If firmware treats STATUS0 sticky bits as a fault source, poll STATUS0 on a regular cadence and service when TIMEOUT_STICKY, STALE_STICKY, or ENVELOPE_STICKY asserts.
After servicing, write CTRL0.CLR_STICKY=1 to clear sticky fault visibility.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is custom byte-addressed and does not imply AXI, APB, or any other specific bus fabric.
No new hierarchy or top-level ports are invented; this is register-map-only content compatible with adaptive_aero_control_top.
